headline: DOM Overlay の focus 復帰を行単位で判定する
headlineEn: Judging DOM Overlay focus recovery row by row
summary: W3C WebXR Device API、Immersive Web DOM Overlays、MDN DOM overlay / domOverlayState、Immersive Web specs index、Meta Immersive Web SDK overview を参照し、DOM Overlay の focus 所有権を XR world select へ戻す本命サンプルと、pinch / gaze / DOM hover の近接入力を debounce する派生サンプルを追加しました。
summaryEn: After checking the W3C WebXR Device API, Immersive Web DOM Overlays, MDN DOM overlay / domOverlayState, the Immersive Web specs index, and Meta's Immersive Web SDK overview, today's original work adds a main sample that routes DOM Overlay focus ownership back to XR world select, plus a derivative sample that debounces nearby pinch / gaze / DOM hover intents.
keyTopics: W3C WebXR Device API は 2026年6月9日の Candidate Recommendation Draft が最新公開版で、session、input、visibility、security/privacy をまとめて見る基準になります。
WebXR DOM Overlays Module は `beforexrselect` と overlay root を通じて、DOM UI と XR world select の所有権を事前に分ける設計を与えています。
MDN の WebXR DOM overlays ガイドと `XRSession.domOverlayState` は、overlay の表示種別や CSS `:xr-overlay` を扱う時の実装メモとして使えます。
Immersive Web の仕様一覧では Device API、DOM Overlay、Hand Input、Layers、Depth Sensing などを横断して参照でき、日次サンプルの次テーマを選びやすいです。
今日の公開カードは外部デモではなく、自作の `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix` と `Pinch Gaze Intent Debounce Replayer` の2本です。
keyTopicsEn: The W3C WebXR Device API Candidate Recommendation Draft dated June 9, 2026 is the latest published anchor for session, input, visibility, and security/privacy behavior.
The WebXR DOM Overlays Module uses `beforexrselect` and an overlay root to separate ownership between DOM UI and XR world select before an action commits.
MDN's WebXR DOM overlays guide and `XRSession.domOverlayState` page provide practical notes for overlay type and CSS `:xr-overlay` handling.
The Immersive Web specs index is useful for scanning Device API, DOM Overlay, Hand Input, Layers, Depth Sensing, and related modules when choosing the next sample theme.
Today's public cards are the original workspace samples `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix` and `Pinch Gaze Intent Debounce Replayer`, not external demos.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: 9月23日は DOM Overlay と XR world select の二重発火を arbitration row にしました。今日はその次の段階として、DOM Overlay の text field や button に残った focus を、いつ XR world reticle へ返してよいかを扱います。`beforexrselect` は action の衝突を止める入口ですが、実アプリでは keyboard intent、overlay state、visibility、ray confidence が揃わないと、復帰したつもりの select が DOM に残ったり world に二重 commit されたりします。そこを matrix と ledger にするのが今日の面白い点です。
sections.bodyEn: September 23 turned duplicate DOM Overlay and XR world select events into arbitration rows. Today takes the next step: deciding when focus left on a DOM Overlay text field or button can safely return to the XR world reticle. `beforexrselect` is the entry point for stopping action collisions, but production apps also need keyboard intent, overlay state, visibility, and ray confidence. Without those, a supposedly recovered select can stay in DOM or double-commit to the world. Today's samples make that recovery visible as a matrix and ledger.

links.label: Immersive Web: WebXR DOM Overlays Module

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命サンプル `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix` は focus owner、`beforexrselect`、`domOverlayState`、visibility、keyboard intent、ray confidence を操作し、`dom-focus`、`dom-action`、`world-resume`、`recover-focus`、`dual-guard`、`hold-hidden` を出します。派生サンプル `Pinch Gaze Intent Debounce Replayer` は hand pinch、gaze dwell、DOM hover が近いタイミングで発生した時に、`pinch-commit`、`gaze-commit`、`dom-suppress-xr`、`intent-merge`、`split-guard`、`preview-hold` のどれに落とすかを replay します。
sections.bodyEn: The main sample, `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix`, lets you adjust focus owner, `beforexrselect`, `domOverlayState`, visibility, keyboard intent, and ray confidence, then emits `dom-focus`, `dom-action`, `world-resume`, `recover-focus`, `dual-guard`, or `hold-hidden`. The derivative sample, `Pinch Gaze Intent Debounce Replayer`, replays nearby hand pinch, gaze dwell, and DOM hover events and classifies them as `pinch-commit`, `gaze-commit`, `dom-suppress-xr`, `intent-merge`, `split-guard`, or `preview-hold`.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: DOM Overlay を使う時は、単に `preventDefault()` したかどうかだけでなく、active element、keyboard composition、session visibility、`domOverlayState.type`、target ray pose の新鮮さを同じ row に保存すると、あとから replay しやすくなります。gaze と hand pinch が同時に来る端末では、数十 ms の debounce window を持ち、同一 target なら merge、別 target なら guard、DOM hover が強ければ XR select を suppress する、といった policy を JSON として持つと調整しやすいです。
sections.bodyEn: When using DOM Overlay, record not only whether `preventDefault()` happened, but also the active element, keyboard composition, session visibility, `domOverlayState.type`, and target ray pose freshness in the same row. That makes later replay much easier. On devices where gaze and hand pinch can arrive together, keep a small debounce window: merge when they agree on the same target, guard when they point to different targets, and suppress XR select when DOM hover has strong ownership. Keeping that policy as JSON makes it tunable.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ
sections.body: 今日の row は、9月17日の IndexedDB logger、9月21日の session context merge store、9月22日の trust floor と相性が良いです。入力行を保存しておけば、展示 UI の誤操作リプレイ、業務用 XR の承認ボタンの監査、AI による `なぜ押された/押されなかったか` の説明生成、またはカメラ/音声イベントと合わせたマルチモーダル intent 判定に使えます。
sections.bodyEn: Today's rows fit well with the September 17 IndexedDB logger, September 21 session context merge store, and September 22 trust floor. Persisting these input rows enables misoperation replay for installations, audit trails for operational XR approval buttons, AI-generated explanations for why an action did or did not commit, and multimodal intent classification when combined with camera or audio events.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: WebXR DOM Overlays Module の `beforexrselect`、MDN の `domOverlayState` と CSS `:xr-overlay`、W3C WebXR Device API の input / visibility / security privacy 章、Immersive Web の Hand Input と input profiles 周辺を続けて見ます。次は今日の focus recovery row を実 `document.activeElement`、composition event、`selectstart/select/selectend` listener に接続し、保存済み session context と一緒に replay する実測版に進めたいです。
sections.bodyEn: Keep watching `beforexrselect` in the WebXR DOM Overlays Module, MDN `domOverlayState` and CSS `:xr-overlay`, the input / visibility / security privacy sections of the W3C WebXR Device API, and Immersive Web Hand Input / input profiles work. Next, connect today's focus recovery rows to real `document.activeElement`, composition events, and `selectstart/select/selectend` listeners, then replay them with stored session context.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix` で focus owner を `DOM text field`、keyboard intent を高め、`beforexrselect` を `preventDefault` にすると `dom-focus` になります。次に focus owner を `XR world` に変えると `world-resume` へ戻り、復帰の条件が見えます。派生側では `mixed`、`same target`、delta 低め、pinch / gaze 高めにすると `intent-merge` になり、split targets にすると `split-guard` へ落ちます。
sections.bodyEn: In `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix`, set focus owner to `DOM text field`, raise keyboard intent, and set `beforexrselect` to `preventDefault` to get `dom-focus`. Change focus owner to `XR world` and it returns to `world-resume`, showing the recovery conditions. In the derivative sample, choose `mixed`, `same target`, low delta, and high pinch / gaze to get `intent-merge`; switch to split targets to fall into `split-guard`.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: W3C WebXR Device API、Immersive Web DOM Overlays、MDN WebXR DOM overlays、MDN `XRSession.domOverlayState`、Immersive Web specs index、Meta Immersive Web SDK overview を確認。設計: 1本目は overlay focus と world resume の recovery matrix、2本目は pinch / gaze / DOM hover の debounce replayer。実装: `outputs/2026-09-24_html_overlay_focus_recovery_matrix.html` と `outputs/2026-09-24_html_pinch_gaze_intent_debounce_replayer.html` を追加。検証: JSON parse、HTML 内 script 構文、gallery 再生成、publish、公開反映を確認する。
sections.bodyEn: Research: checked the W3C WebXR Device API, Immersive Web DOM Overlays, MDN WebXR DOM overlays, MDN `XRSession.domOverlayState`, the Immersive Web specs index, and Meta's Immersive Web SDK overview. Design: make the first sample a recovery matrix for overlay focus and world resume, and the second a debounce replayer for pinch / gaze / DOM hover. Implementation: add `outputs/2026-09-24_html_overlay_focus_recovery_matrix.html` and `outputs/2026-09-24_html_pinch_gaze_intent_debounce_replayer.html`. Validation: parse JSON, check embedded HTML scripts, rebuild the gallery, publish, and confirm publication.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 9月後半の流れは、起動前の trust、起動直後の session context、DOM Overlay の select arbitration、そして focus 復帰へ進んでいます。XR UI の難しさは `押す対象` だけでなく、DOM、world、hand、gaze、keyboard が短い時間窓で同じ intent を共有する点です。今日の2本は、その共有を `いつ返すか` と `どれを勝たせるか` に分け、後で実機ログに差し替えられる形にした部品です。
sections.bodyEn: The late-September thread now runs from pre-launch trust to post-launch session context, DOM Overlay select arbitration, and focus recovery. XR UI is difficult not only because of what is pressed, but because DOM, world, hand, gaze, and keyboard can share the same intent in a short time window. Today's two samples split that problem into when to return ownership and which intent wins, while keeping the shape replaceable with real device logs later.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 本命として採用した候補は `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix` です。何が動くか: focus owner、`beforexrselect`、`domOverlayState`、visibility、keyboard intent、ray confidence から DOM focus 維持 / DOM action / world resume / focus recovery / dual guard / hidden hold を判定し、ledger と JSON row を出します。次に足すなら、実 `document.activeElement` と composition event を接続します。派生として `Pinch Gaze Intent Debounce Replayer` も実装しました。何が動くか: pinch closure、gaze dwell、DOM hover、target overlap、delta ms、jitter から commit / suppress / merge / guard / hold を分類します。次に足すなら、`XRHand` の pinch 距離と gaze reticle dwell を同じ IndexedDB row に保存します。
sections.bodyEn: The selected main prototype is `Overlay Focus Recovery Matrix`. What it does: judges DOM focus retention / DOM action / world resume / focus recovery / dual guard / hidden hold from focus owner, `beforexrselect`, `domOverlayState`, visibility, keyboard intent, and ray confidence, then emits a ledger and JSON rows. Next addition: connect real `document.activeElement` and composition events. The derivative `Pinch Gaze Intent Debounce Replayer` was also implemented. What it does: classifies commit / suppress / merge / guard / hold from pinch closure, gaze dwell, DOM hover, target overlap, delta ms, and jitter. Next addition: store `XRHand` pinch distance and gaze reticle dwell in the same IndexedDB row.
